definition: A complex number written as $r(\cos\theta + \mathrm{i}\sin\theta) = r\,\mathrm{cis}\,\theta$, where $r > 0$ is its modulus and $\theta$ its argument.
A complex number written as $r\mathrm{e}^{\mathrm{i}\theta}$, where $r > 0$ is its modulus and $\theta$ its argument; the polar form written as a power of $\mathrm{e}$.
